hooks.command: jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("(^|[\\n|;&(])\\s*(sed|grep|egrep|fgrep)(\\s|$)")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Use sd instead of sed and rg instead of grep (see AGENTS.md)."}} else empty end'

jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("docs/team/core\\.md$")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"docs/team/core.md is the fixed core of the team: only the user changes it."}} else empty end'
echo 'If this message points out a defect in a model that the critic did not list, follow "When the critic misses something" in docs/art/pipeline.md in this turn, without being asked.'
